claim.en: In 2023, as newly elected mayor of Hrabušice, whose municipality administers five gorges of Slovak Paradise, Kacvinský announced plans for year-round entrance fees via payment terminals at the gorges.
claim.sk: V roku 2023 Kacvinský ako novozvolený starosta Hrabušíc, ktoré spravujú päť roklín Slovenského raja, ohlásil plán celoročného vyberania vstupného cez platobné terminály pri vstupe do roklín.

findings.quote: This year the Hrabušice municipality, as the administrator of the local five gorges, is planning several innovations, including the purchase and installation of payment terminals at the entrance to the gorges, mayor Marcel Kacvinský told the TASR newswire. Year-round admission Kacvinský, as the newly elected mayor, announced plans to collect entrance fees to Slovak Paradise all year round through payment terminals.
findings.title: Slovak Paradise re-opens with plans for payment terminals
